notes: On 23 March 2020, Boko Haram were repulsed by the military after staging an attack on the village of Goshikale in Mora subdivision (Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord). Militants destroyed the local hospital and looted several houses, taking away 3 motorcycles.

On 4 September 2022, military forces shot and killed a man in Besali (Wabane, Lebialem, Sud-Ouest) after he was mistaken for a separatist fighter following an exchange of fire between soldiers and Ambazonia Liberation Army fighters.

Around 28 July 2023 (as reported), state security forces shot and killed two Ambazonian Separatists in Kumbo commune, coded to Kumbo (Bui, Nord-Ouest) whom they had captured on 28 July (coded separately).
Looting: Around 15 July 2020 (month of), the military forces raided Bengang village, Batibo subdivision (Momo, Nord-Ouest). They shot in the air, and then looted property.

On 23 November 2023, the military forces ambushed Ambazonian Separatists from the Restoration Forces onboard a motorcycle in Konye (Konye, Meme, Sud-Ouest). The military forces members shot and injured one.
On 18 December 2023, the military forces attacked Ambazonian Separatists leading to a clash in Bai Panya (Kumba 1, Meme, Sud-Ouest). Two Ambazonian Separatists were killed and four others arrested.
On 17 August 2020, the military forces engaged in a fire fight with Ambazonian separatists in Makanga village, Muyuka subdivision (Fako, Sud-Ouest). 1 person was killed, and another arrested.

Looting: Around 17 March 2024 (as reported), an unidentified armed group suspected of being ISWAP or Boko Haram militants looted food items, clothing and 1 bicycle in Ganse (Kolofata, Mayo-Sava, Extreme-Nord).
On 16 April 2020, military forces killed three former Ambazonian separatists in Balikumbat town (Ngo-ketunjia, Nord-Ouest).
On 13 January 2021, Ambazonian separatists kidnapped a truck driver and his assistant in Bukow village, Ndop subdivision (Ngo-Ketunjia, Nord-Ouest).

On 8 April 2023, the State security forces, coded as the military force, clashed with the Ambazonian Separatists in Batibo (Batibo, Momo, Nord-Ouest). There were no fatalities. During the operation, the military forces arrested about 30 civilians from several villages and moved them to their base.

Property destruction: On 18 March 2022, suspected military forces burnt down 2 shops in Ndop (Ndop, Ngo-Ketunjia, Nord-Ouest) for failing to open their stores on Mondays. The Ambazonian Separatist fighters had imposed lockdown Mondays.

On 14 January 2020, the military forces engaged in a fire fight with Ambazonian separatists in Peng village, Tombel subdivision (Kupe-Manenguba, Sud-Ouest) [coded: Tombel]. Two civilians were killed after they were reportedly flagged as Ambazonian fighters.
On 21 November 2020, Ambazonian separatists kidnapped a retired military officer from his home in Mankon town, Bamenda 2 subdivision (Bamenda - Mankon, Mezam, Nord-Ouest).

On 1 October 2020, the military forces destroyed buildings in Akum town (Mezam, Nord-Ouest), in retaliation for writings on a vehicle that supported the separatists. No fatality and/or casualty reported.

Looting: On 25 November 2022, Ambazonian Separatists abducted the body of a deceased person in Kai, Mbengwi commune, coded to Mbengwi (Momo, Nord-Ouest). The group accused the family of the deceased of not supporting the struggle against the military. They later released the dead body after the family had paid an unspecified amount of money.
